reason: The current allowed model set differs from the historical evaluation roster. Updating the evaluation roster changes its acceptance population.
requiredRerun: Run all retained new cases and paired irrelevant no-memory controls with explicitly materialized 1M model metadata. Do not carry over the 128k results as acceptance evidence.
retentionRule: Keep 4 to 6 cases per new family. Each retained case needs at least one completed scored failure on an approved roster model. Execution errors do not qualify.
alternative: Keep the existing roster and redesign candidates for the allowed glm-5.3 model without changing grading or counting execution errors as failures.

approval.decision: Use the three currently allowed models and rerun all retained candidates plus paired irrelevant no-memory controls with an explicit 1000000 context window.
